product.title: norml coffee ppl subscription - 120g (4.23oz)
product.body_html:
Month #8: TNT Flower Touch

What is the norml sub? 
- 2 x 60g bags of coffee (120g total) of the same coffee, with a new coffee every month
- The two bags are the same coffee roasted two different ways, on two different roasters 
- Main goal is to showcase how the same coffee can be expressed in two different ways through roasting craftsmanship

Our plan is to keep building with them over time, bringing you a survey of varietals and processing styles from the same farms each year.

Another big goal with this subscription is to do represent the coffees we bring in as well as we can, to the best of our abilities. We want to roast each and every coffee in a way that truly represents the work that went into it, out of respect for the producers who make it possible.

As roasters, we love the challenge of adapting our approach based on how each coffee tastes, and we love playing with and creating something on different machines. It pushes us to explore, experiment, and learn more about the craft of roasting with every new coffee we bring in, and it's something we want to share with as many people as we can.

Subscriptions after the initial order will be billed by the 14th of every month, roasted by the following Wednesday, and shipped out on the business day following the roast date. Orders placed after the 14th of the month will receive the next month's subscription coffee.

    Past coffees:

    Month #1 - January 14, 2026 roast date: 2x 60g bags of Hacienda La Florida White Honey Mejorado, one roasted on the Stronghold and one on the Kaffelogic.

    Month #2 - February 18, 2026 roast date: 2x 60g bags of Hacienda La Florida Anaerobic Washed Sidra, roasted on the Roest L200 Ultra. One roast will be a 200g batch in counterflow mode, and the other a 100g batch in regular mode.

    Month #3 - March 18, 2026 roast date: TNT Coffee Lab. One 60g bag is a washed process called Paradise with cherries from Santamaria, and the other 60g bag is a koji natural process coffee called Samurai with cherries from Auromar.

    Month #4 - April 15, 2026 roast date: TNT Coffee Lab. One 60g bag is a washed process gesha called Flower Touch, and the other 60g is a honey process gesha called Bumblebee, both using cherries from Santamaria.

    Month #5 - May 17, 2026 roast date: Both coffees are the Hacienda El Obraje classic washed process. Roast A is an ultralight profile that is a juicier roast than the usual profile, and roast B is the norml reference profile.

    Month #6 - June 19, 2026 roast date: Both coffees are the Andcoffee Thermal Shock Honey Process 74112, 74158 varietals. Roast A is an ultralight profile that is a juicier roast than the usual profile, and roast B is the norml reference profile.

    Month #7 - July 15, 2026 roast date: Both coffees are the La Guadua  washed gesha roast profile. Roast A is our new reference profile that is a juicier roast than roast B, and roast B tries to push the boundaries of how just light the roast can go for a more floral expression of the same coffee.

    Month #8: Lerida Michela Estate - Washed Gesha Lot 1137
    Roast A: roasted on a Loring that expresses more fruit forward character like white nectarine, lime and oolong tea
    Roast B: roasted on a Roest L200 Ultra that tastes like chicken nuggets
